tasks.title: Announcement #65
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university event.
tasks.transcript: Attention everyone. We are thrilled to announce that the university's annual Spring Gala will be held next Saturday at 7 p.m. in the Grand Ballroom. There will be dinner, dancing and a live band. We look forward to seeing you there.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：We are thrilled to announce that the university's annual Spring Gala will be held next Saturday at 7 p.m. in the Grand Ballroom. 选项分析： A. An upcoming spring event 一场即将到来的春季活动。公告明确宣布年度春季盛典（Spring Gala）的时间地点，所以A选项正确。 B. A new band performance 一场新的乐队表演。公告中提到有现场乐队，但这是盛典的一部分，不是主要内容，所以B选项错误。 C. A dinner menu update 晚餐菜单的更新。公告中未提及菜单更新，所以C选项错误。 D. A university meeting 一次大学会议。公告中未提及会议，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker hope the listeners will do?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：说话者希望听众做什么？ 定位原文：We look forward to seeing you there. 选项分析： A. Attend the Spring Gala 参加春季盛典。说话者说“期待在那里见到你”，即希望听众到场参加春季盛典，所以A选项正确。 B. Volunteer for the event 为活动做志愿者。公告中未提及招募志愿者，所以B选项错误。 C. Participate in a dance competition 参加舞蹈比赛。公告中未提及舞蹈比赛，所以C选项错误。 D. Join the university band 加入大学乐队。公告中未提及加入乐队，所以D选项错误。
